items.q: History said that the famous poet Francois Villon had been imprisoned there.

ctx.x: Martial was actually from Algeria. His style was something similar to Oscar Peterson, with a technique like the great Art Tatum and he accompanied me beautifully, although my style was not as modern as that of Dizzy Gillespie and others of that epoch. I really enjoyed playing with Martial who was full of ideas, very inspiring.

I stayed at the Ringside until the 4th of August and started at a place called Metro Jazz, which became the Trois Maillets (three hammers). This place was on the left bank in the Latin Quarter, near the famous Notre Dame church. I was living on the left bank and the Metro Jazz club was about 10 minutes walk from my hotel. The owner of the Trois Maillets was a lady named Denise Calve who had been an actress. The club was a cellar of the 12th century, very well preserved and had been a prison. History said that the…

Jimmy Wright and Kirby Alexander arrived around the 20th of September and also a very well known pianist in the States who had become quite popular in France in the middle thirties. His name was Garland Wilson, known by his musician friends as "Mother". Garland had been engaged to entertain at a famous night spot called "the Boeuf sur le Toit" where he and the well known female pianist, Una Mae Carlisle, had worked together in the thirties until the second world war started.
